system.description: Your Checks to Grapple or Shove Targets that are smaller than you are Favored, and you can use Beings that are your size or smaller as a 2H Grip d4 Brawl Weapon with the Defense property that deals its damage to both the Target and itself on a hit. If you reduce damage with a Being this way, it still takes the full damage. Your attacks with it maintain the grapple.
